notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only page about this lookout is its Canada Lookouts entry, which gives a name, region, coordinates and elevation and nothing else. The page gives no unit for elevation; metres are assumed, as in the record. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, status or access was found in the cache or in two searches. The story is shorter than the 120-word guide floor because it omits sentences about missing evidence. Do not confuse this with the Cascade Lookout in E.C. Manning Provincial Park, which search results showed and which is a different tower (not read, not used). The wildbluebell sentence is general context only; it does not describe this tower.
